title: AJISAI: Automated Justification-based Imaging and Self-calibration for ALMA Infrastructure

creators.name: Yamaguchi, Masayuki
creators.affiliation: Kyushu University / National Astronomical Observatory of Japan

description: AJISAI is a Python package for fully automated and reproducible iterative self-calibration of ALMA continuum data with CASA. It executes a fixed schedule of phase-only and amplitude self-calibration rounds, selects the CLEAN image with the highest dynamic range as the final product, and records the justification for every parameter choice in a machine-readable log.
